notes:
V4.0.0 — BAPTOU rebrand + revenue split + UI polish.

💰  REVENUE SPLIT (V4.0.0.txt items 1 & 2)
• BOSS_ADMIN-only REVENUE SPLIT card in the ADMIN tab. Set three percentages that must sum to 100:
    SELLER %   → publisher of the bot
    ADMIN %    → split equally among every admin-role user
    RUNNING %  → virtual platform balance (covers API keys + hosting)
• Every paid bot purchase (price_credits > 0) automatically distributes credits across these three buckets.
• Pre-flight balance check on /bots/{slug}/download (returns 402 if buyer can't afford the price).
• Defaults: 90 / 5 / 5. Running-balance counter shown in the admin UI in both credits and dollars (1 ◊ = $0.01).

🅱  BAPTOU REBRAND
• Title bar reads 'BAPTOU Trading Platform' (data folder stays %LocalAppData%\APEX Trading Platform so existing settings + keys survive).
• Login window logo replaced with '◈ BAPTOU'.
• Server description updated.
• Traditional green outline color replaced with a softer teal-cyan (#3eb8a4) throughout the default theme.
• Note: the new graphical logo (B-shaped, green-top / red-bottom) needs an actual artist or designer — drop a 256×256 PNG in assets/ as icon.png and I'll convert it to .ico.

🎨  UI POLISH (V4.0.0.txt items 4-9)
• Overview's bot-card row now WRAPS — 4+ bots stack into rows of 3, no more cut-off cards.
• FRIENDS list shows each accepted friend's shared stats inline under their row (TODAY / MONTH / YEAR + broker, with 'not sharing X' placeholders for fields they haven't enabled).
• Bot tabs' play / stop / restart buttons are now nearly double size (54 px tall, 120-140 px wide) and stay visible without hovering.
• MORE BOTS gains an explicit '⬆ Publish to marketplace' button next to UPLOAD CUSTOM BOT for the 'test locally first, then publish' workflow.
